facts.business: Zodiac Energy Limited is an integrated energy company engaged in solar EPC, independent power production (IPP), battery energy storage systems (BESS), and integrated renewable energy infrastructure development.

capacity_or_capex.item: Commissioned Solar Project for Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation

guidance_or_targets.statement: Build an IPP portfolio of approximately 400 MW
Develop manufacturing of BESS products ranging from residential and commercial applications to utility-scale energy storage projects
Focus significantly on large-scale government renewable energy projects integrating generation, transmission, storage and other energy infrastructure
Develop integrated Wind-Solar Hybrid parks with land, generation, transmission, storage and associated facilities planned together

key_risks: Revenue recognition susceptibility to material misstatement due to cut-off and estimation of electricity sales
Capitalization and lease accounting for solar power plants involving significant management judgment
Expected credit loss on trade receivables with increasing provision (Rs 2.52 crore as of March 2026)
Inventory obsolescence with items carried at nil value
Execution risk in scaling IPP, BESS and integrated energy projects simultaneously
Dependence on government renewable energy projects for growth
Technology and market risk in emerging BESS segment
facts.related_party_note: Related party trade receivables of Rs 4.34 crore as of March 2025 (nil as of March 2026); vehicles in the name of directors; advances to employees
